invariant:
fact eligible: bool
fact fresh: bool
check !eligible || fresh

next.eligible:
fact a: bool
fact b: bool
fact eligible: bool
fact fresh: bool
check !(!a && b) && (eligible || (a && b && fresh))
next.fresh:
fact a: bool
fact b: bool
fact eligible: bool
fact fresh: bool
check !(!a && b) && (fresh || (a && !b))
